title.zh: 冰冻肥皂泡 · 水膜里的结晶
title.en: Frozen Soap Bubbles · Ice in a Thin Film

desc.zh: 亲手放入冰核，对比枝状生长、潜热驱动的流动与两种环境的冻结趋势，分清薄膜和冰晶的颜色。
desc.en: Seed a crystal, compare branching growth and heat-driven transport in two environments, and separate film color from ice optics.
